statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH (yellow). Tail 23% sits in the watch band, below the block threshold.
recommendation: A narrow evidence-based danger window is flagged for 13:00-15:00 UTC, covering the 13:30 UTC Nasdaq cash open and the first cash hour, where conditional Tail maps into the block band. Outside that window the mapped state remains WATCH with Tail below the block threshold. Existing-position management and emergency protection remain unchanged.
headline: Post-FOMC relief grind extends to a new session high as VIX, yields and crude all ease; Tail firms to the upper watch band into the cash open
body: The Federal Reserve raised its target range 25bp to 3.75-4.00% on September 16 in a unanimous 12-0 vote, its first increase since 2023, and the projections showed 16 of 18 officials penciling in a further increase this year. Nasdaq-100 cash sold off to 28,753.29 during that repricing before recovering to close at 28,945.06 (+0.02%), a genuine retracement that argues against a no-retracement regime. Through the European morning the relief move extended rather than stalled: NQ futures trade at 29,664.00 (+1.39%) against a 29,271.00 prior close, with a session range of 29,247.75-29,680.75 leaving price roughly 17 points below a high set within the last hour. Cross-assets have eased further in the same direction: VIX is 15.67 (-11.5%) and near its session low against a 17.20 prior close, the 10-year yield is 4.965% (-3.9bp) and the 2-year 4.688% (-3.9bp), while WTI has broken below $100 to $99.33 (-3.0%) and Brent to $101.86 (-3.75%) as Saudi Arabia works to restore roughly half of the drone-damaged East-West pipeline within days. Shared Finviz context was fresh but partial, with futures and calendar sections unavailable; its breadth, megacap and semiconductor sections were internally consistent with independently verified reporting of technology leadership, showing all eight tracked megacaps higher and semiconductors among the strongest industries. The persistent one-way overnight direction and the hold near the session extreme are the genuine Tail amplifiers and lift Tail one point to 23. The offsets remain substantial: a sharply decaying volatility surface, easing yields, falling crude, yesterday's orderly post-event retracement and a 433-point session range built from a real low rather than a vertical gap. Cross-asset alignment is risk-positive with volatility falling, which is not the configuration that historically denies mean reversion. Stress eases to 59 as crude drops below $100 and the volatility surface normalises, while a newly restarted hiking cycle, a 10-year yield near 5% and the continuing Strait of Hormuz disruption keep it in the elevated band. The 12:30 UTC data cluster releases at the assessment cutoff and its actuals could not be verified in time, so it is treated as an unresolved checkpoint rather than scored evidence.

lookbackSummary: Over the past 24 hours the assessment stayed mostly in the low-to-watch Tail band, with one orange excursion to Tail 31% in the 19:00 UTC hour as the FOMC statement and the Warsh press conference drove a sharp Nasdaq-100 sell-off toward 28,753. That move retraced into the cash close and Tail fell back to 16-20% overnight. Stress decayed steadily from the high 70s before the decision to the low 60s this morning as volatility normalised, yields eased back below 5% and crude fell on Saudi pipeline repair guidance. The most recent seven hours have carried a trend-up mode with Tail at 19-22% as the relief grind extended toward the session high.
outlookSummary: The forecast maps conditional Tail into the block band for the 13:00 and 14:00 UTC hours, covering the 13:30 UTC Nasdaq cash open and the first cash hour. An aligned bullish regime running into the New York open is the configuration most capable of producing opening-auction continuation with shallow pullbacks, so the 13:00 UTC hour carries the peak conditional Tail of 27. Conditional Tail then decays through the US afternoon as the opening imbalance clears, rises modestly into the 19:00 UTC power hour, and falls below the watch threshold after the cash close as the event stack empties. It drifts back to the watch band during Friday's European morning ahead of 13:15 UTC industrial production. Confidence declines with distance from the evidence cutoff, reaching the low end of the solid band at the end of the horizon. Next-week US calendar items are included where release times were verified.
